esignAnchor.title: Signature position in the contract text
esignAnchor.hint: When sending for signature, the system looks for these phrases in the contract's final signature block (one per line, top first) and places the signature field right below. Not found ⇒ a signature page is appended.
esignAnchor.saveErr: Could not save the phrases (each party needs at least one phrase, 2–60 characters).
